description: cross-cylinders-common with the tool turned about its own axis so its seam runs through the crossing vertex (0, R, 0): the seam's ruling is tangent to the target's wall there — the vertex's normal is the axes' common perpendicular — so the seam touches the wall at the section vertex two ellipses made instead of piercing it. The touch lands on that vertex and cuts the seam there; the two lenses on the tool's wall reach the seam only at their corners (plans/cylinder-cylinder-booleans step 3). The Steinmetz solid, 16R³/3, area 16R²

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE also cuts the section arc that runs through an ellipse's parameter origin there, one more vertex and edge, as in cross-cylinders-common; Arris's edge range crosses the period once (E1). The tool's seam reaches the common only at the crossing vertex, so neither side has a seam edge of the tool
